metadata.analyzed_by: AWS Transform Custom — Agentic Readiness Analysis
metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (Python/Django) with database connection and HTTP endpoints present. Single deployable service with entry points via Django views.
metadata.archetype_justification: PostgreSQL database with CRUD operations on ticket entities. Django admin installed for entity lifecycle management. User-specific data (requester field).

findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes Django views serving HTML responses via raw SQL. No REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface exists. Integration requires reverse-engineering HTML views or direct database access.
findings.gap: No API layer exists. Views return HTML via render_to_response and raw HttpResponse. No JSON endpoints, no API documentation.
findings.recommendation: Create a REST API layer (Django REST Framework or FastAPI) that exposes ticket operations as JSON endpoints with documented contracts. Requires Python/Django upgrade first.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable API specification exists in the repository.
findings.gap: Agent tool generation requires fully manual authoring with no spec to validate against.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI specification documenting all endpoints. Preferably auto-generated from API framework annotations.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. DEBUG = True returns full HTML stack traces. No error codes, no machine-readable error format.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors. No structured error format exists.
findings.recommendation: Implement consistent JSON error response format with error code, message, and retryable indicator across all endpoints.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency mechanisms exist. No idempotency keys, no unique constraint enforcement on business keys. Django admin provides write operations without idempotency guarantees.
findings.gap: Write operations vulnerable to duplication on agent retry. No idempotency key support.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency keys on all write endpoints once a proper API layer exists.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanisms exist
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system exposes write operations via Django admin and is a CRUD ticketing app. No idempotency keys or unique business key enforcement exists.

findings.title: HTML Response Format
findings.description: API responses are HTML — render_to_response templates and raw HTML strings. No JSON serialization or structured response format.
findings.gap: LLMs cannot consume HTML responses effectively. Any agent integration requires HTML-to-data parsing or response format rewrite.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to JSON responses for all agent-facing endpoints.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, no SNS/EventBridge/SQS integration, no Kafka, no CDC pipelines.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to ticket state changes without polling.
findings.recommendation: Implement SNS/EventBridge notifications on ticket status changes for event-driven agent integration.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation and no rate limit response headers. No API Gateway usage plans.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle. Undocumented limits cause unpredictable failures.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and implement rate limit response headers once a proper API layer exists.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Session-based Django auth only. No OAuth2 client credentials, no API keys with principal attribution, no mTLS, no service accounts.
findings.gap: Agents cannot authenticate without human credentials (username/password session login).
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials flow or API key authentication with per-agent principal attribution.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Django built-in auth provides only basic user/superuser differentiation. No fine-grained RBAC, no per-resource permission scoping.
findings.gap: No mechanism to grant an agent read-only access to specific resources without inheriting broader privileges.
findings.recommendation: Implement permission framework with per-resource scoping or deploy API Gateway with resource-level policies.

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Views perform no permission checks — any authenticated user can execute any operation.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-only vs write access per resource type for agents.
findings.recommendation: Add action-level permission checks to all views/endpoints.

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism. No JWT parsing, no OAuth2 on-behalf-of flows, no token exchange.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement JWT-based identity propagation with distinct flows for service-to-service and user-delegated calls.

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: SECRET_KEY and database password are hardcoded in settings.py committed to git. No secrets management system, no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials in source code are exposed to anyone with repository access and persist in git history.
findings.recommendation: Remove all hardcoded credentials. Migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with rotation policies.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit trail, no log storage configuration. Only a debug print statement.
findings.gap: No tamper-evident audit trail for agent actions. No principal logging for any operation.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging with principal attribution, stored in CloudTrail or equivalent with object lock.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging exists
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents require full audit attribution. No audit logging of any kind exists in this application.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension Mechanism
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Session-based auth only with no key management.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without taking down the entire application.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key-based auth with per-agent keys that can be individually revoked.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanisms. No saga patterns, no undo endpoints, no compensating transactions, no Step Functions.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step operations leave the system in partial state with no recovery path.
findings.recommendation: Implement transaction boundaries with explicit rollback on failure for multi-step ticket operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation logic exists
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents executing multi-step workflows on this ticketing system have no rollback mechanism for partial failures.

findings.title: State Not Machine-Queryable
findings.description: Views query ticket state but return HTML, not a machine-queryable format. No JSON endpoints for state inspection.
findings.gap: Agents cannot programmatically inspect ticket state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Expose ticket state as JSON endpoints with filtering and field selection.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No optimistic locking, no pessimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conflict resolution logic.
findings.gap: Multiple concurrent agent instances could create race conditions corrupting ticket state.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields on ticket entities.

findings.title: No Circuit Breakers or Resilience
findings.description: No circuit breakers, retry logic, or timeout configurations. SMTP relay connection has no resilience patterns.
findings.gap: Failures in email relay cascade back to agents calling the system.
findings.recommendation: Implement circuit breaker patterns for all external calls including SMTP relay.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, no WAF, no application-level rate limiting middleware.
findings.gap: Runaway agent loops can overwhelm the application at machine speed.
findings.recommendation: Deploy rate limiting immediately — at minimum Apache-level, ideally API Gateway with per-caller throttle.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. No maximum records modified per run, no spend caps, no operation-count limits.
findings.gap: Agent errors have unbounded blast radius — could modify or delete unlimited records.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-caller transaction limits.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state mechanism. All write operations immediately committed. No approval workflows.
findings.gap: No mechanism for an agent to propose changes for human review before commitment.
findings.recommendation: Add PENDING/DRAFT status to ticket state machine allowing agent-proposed changes to await confirmation.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval gate mechanism. No configurable operation-level flags, no approval endpoints.
findings.gap: Cannot require human approval for high-risk agent operations.
findings.recommendation: Implement per-operation approval gates configurable by operation type.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single production EC2 with manual git pull deployment.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create Docker Compose local development environment with seed data.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped in API Responses
findings.description: Stage A: Yes — stores employee PII (requester names, emails). Stage B: B1 fires (raw SQL returns all columns unscoped), B2 fires (no access differentiation), B3 absent (no classification metadata).
findings.gap: Agent-facing responses expose all fields including employee PII without scoping. No differentiated access controls.
findings.recommendation: Implement response serialization excluding sensitive fields. Add role-based access differentiation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired (sensitive fields returned unscoped)
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: DATA-Q1 B1 fired because raw SQL returns all columns including requester (employee PII) without filtering. B2 also fires due to no access differentiation.

b1.reasoning: Raw SQL returns all columns including requester PII without exclusion

b2.reasoning: No access control differentiation - single permission level for all data

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: Employee PII stored in PostgreSQL on single EC2 without residency controls. No region constraints, no sovereignty policies, no LLM transmission controls.
findings.gap: Zero data residency controls. Employee PII could be transmitted to any LLM provider jurisdiction without restriction.
findings.recommendation: Document data residency requirements. Implement data classification and transmission controls for LLM interactions.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no data residency controls for employee PII
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores employee PII (requester names in tickets) with zero residency controls. Write-enabled agent could transmit data to any LLM endpoint.

findings.title: No Pagination or Query Limits
findings.description: No pagination, no result limiting, no cursor-based queries. Both ticket_list and ticket_search return unbounded results.
findings.gap: Agents retrieving tickets would get unbounded result sets exhausting LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Add pagination (limit/offset or cursor) to all list and search endpoints.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: No input validation. Raw user input directly interpolated into SQL via Python string formatting, creating SQL injection vulnerabilities in both views.
findings.gap: Complete absence of input validation. SQL injection vulnerabilities. No schema enforcement, no type checking.
findings.recommendation: Replace all string-formatted SQL with parameterized queries immediately. Implement input validation framework.

findings.title: Incomplete Temporal Metadata
findings.description: Only a 'created' field is visible. No updated_at, no timezone normalization, no cache headers, no freshness signaling.
findings.gap: Incomplete temporal metadata for agent reasoning about data freshness.
findings.recommendation: Add updated_at timestamp with UTC normalization. Implement Cache-Control and Last-Modified headers.

findings.title: PII Logged Unredacted
findings.description: User search queries logged via print statement without redaction. ticket_search function prints raw user query which could contain PII.
findings.gap: PII from user-submitted search queries logged unredacted. No PII masking in any logging path.
findings.recommendation: Remove debug print statements. Implement structured logging with PII masking.

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, no completeness monitoring, no duplicate detection, no freshness SLAs.
findings.gap: No quality signals for agent reasoning about data reliability.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring (null rate, duplicate tickets, completeness metrics).

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no breaking change detection. No migration files, no changelog, no contract tests.
findings.gap: Agent tool bindings break silently on any schema or endpoint change.
findings.recommendation: Implement database migrations, API versioning, and breaking change detection in CI.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer describing what data the system holds and what it means semantically.
findings.gap: Agent tool builders must reverse-engineer schema from source code.
findings.recommendation: Document database schema and field semantics.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No tracing (no X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry). No structured logging — only debug print statements. No correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot debug agent-initiated requests through the system.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry or X-Ray instrumentation with structured JSON logging and correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, no monitoring integration. Only Django ADMINS email.
findings.gap: Agent-induced issues undetectable without manual investigation.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms on HTTP error rates and response latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC exists. Manually provisioned single EC2 instance. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.
findings.gap: No peer-reviewed, drift-detected infrastructure governance.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure as Terraform/CDK with PR-based review and drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Deployment is manual git pull + apache restart. No automated testing or contract testing.
findings.gap: API-breaking changes not caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated API contract testing.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback capability. Manual git pull deployment with no version tracking, no blue/green, no canary.
findings.gap: Cannot reliably roll back broken deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback triggers.

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: No test files in repository. README mentions stale unit tests. No API test suites, no integration tests in CI.
findings.gap: No automated test coverage for agent-facing endpoints.
findings.recommendation: Create comprehensive API test suite covering input validation, error responses, and edge cases.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. PostgreSQL on local disk with no KMS encryption, no encrypted EBS volumes.
findings.gap: Sensitive helpdesk data stored unencrypted on disk.
findings.recommendation: Migrate database to RDS with KMS encryption or enable EBS volume encryption.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no evidence of operations exceeding 30 seconds or long-running workflows in this CRUD ticketing system.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no priority provided and service is not identified as P0 or critical path.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names (id, subject, requester, priority, status, created) are human-readable and semantically meaningful. No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry of any kind emitted — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Requires platform modernization (Python/Django upgrade), identity layer implementation, and security hardening.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Implement observability, CI/CD, IaC governance, and data management improvements.
Address INFO findings and remaining quality improvements. Implement event-driven patterns, data quality monitoring, and comprehensive testing.

recommended_actions.rationale: Python 2.7 and Django 1.4 are EOL. Modern frameworks required for all security and API improvements.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine identity support
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine identity is the foundational blocker — all authorization, audit, and suspension capabilities depend on it.

recommended_actions.action: Remove hardcoded credentials and implement secrets management
recommended_actions.rationale: Hardcoded SECRET_KEY and database password are immediate security vulnerabilities.

recommended_actions.action: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution
recommended_actions.rationale: Required for compliance and forensics when agents perform write operations.

recommended_actions.action: Fix SQL injection vulnerabilities and implement input validation
recommended_actions.rationale: SQL injection is a critical security vulnerability exploitable by agents or attackers.

recommended_actions.action: Implement data residency controls and sensitive data scoping
recommended_actions.rationale: Employee PII must be scoped, classified, and residency-controlled before agent access.
